spans.s:
दुन्दम (मः) 1.
m. A sort of drum.

दुन्दु (न्दुः) 2.
m. Vasudeva, the father
of
Krishna; a kind of drum.

दुन्दुभि (भिः) 2.
m. A sort of large
kettle-drum;
Varuna; a demon;
a pair.
f. (भिः-भी) A dice having
twice three spots on it, or a pair
with three spots on each.

दुन्दुमार (रः) 1.
m. A sort of red
worm; smoke of a house; a cat.

दून (नः-ना-नं)
a. Suffering pain
or fatigue; going; shaken.

दूनवत् (वान-वती-वत्)
a. Agita-
ting; distressed; gone.
